dinosaurs: A Tyrannosaurus rex had teeth as long as bananas.
Some dinosaurs had feathers, just like birds.
The Stegosaurus had a brain about the size of a walnut.
Dinosaur eggs could be as big as a football.
Birds are the dinosaurs that are still alive today.
animals: An elephant can't jump, but it can swim.
A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
Cows have best friends and get sad when they're apart.
A snail can sleep for three years.
space: The sun is a star, and it's really, really big.
A day on Venus is longer than a year on Venus.
There are more stars in the sky than grains of sand on all the beaches.
Astronauts grow a little bit taller in space.
The moon is slowly drifting away from the Earth, about as fast as your fingernails grow.
ocean: The blue whale is the biggest animal that has ever lived.
Sea otters hold hands when they sleep so they don't float away.
Most of the ocean has never been explored by people.
Dolphins sleep with one eye open.
